groups.label: Phase 2 — Slack policy, mappings, and suggestions

items.title: Bind structured patches to the exact canonical revision

body.Spec said: Keep full-page review compatible while adding bounded structured patches with stale-target rejection, visible diffs, provenance, and Portable Brain validation.
body.What I did: Added UTF-8 byte-range patch contracts, revision-bound review bindings, derived diffs, CLI and MCP input support, explicit edit-and-approve replacement bodies, and portable-history validation against the parent page.
body.Why: A frozen patch plus the expected published digest prevents a Slack update from silently applying to a changed note while preserving the existing reviewed-publication boundary.
body.Risk: Focused Ruff, mypy, and 23 patch/service/portable tests pass. The broader live MCP subprocess test group could not import open_brain in its spawned interpreter in this run, so full repository verification remains a Phase 4 gate.
body.Followup: Phase 2 adds versioned private Slack policy, explicit mappings, and noteworthy-channel suggestions without capturing unapproved channels.

items.title: Keep Slack selection policy private and owner-controlled

body.Spec said: Use CLI-backed versioned private config, the chosen 24-hour and 1/20/20 heuristic defaults, explicit mappings, a separate suggestions list, and no capture from unapproved channels.
body.What I did: Added owner-only versioned policy state, validated channel and canonical-page mappings, suggestion approve and dismiss commands, status counts, and resumable Slack discovery that scores channel activity plus name/topic keywords.
body.Why: The collector remains the only component with provider credentials and scheduling state, while users can review and change mappings through supported CLI commands instead of editing JSON by hand.
body.Risk: Discovery counts bounded history pages and reads channel metadata but does not create capture intakes for unapproved channels. Focused Ruff, whitespace checks, and 24 Slack tests pass; full verification remains a Phase 4 gate.
body.Followup: Phase 3 consumes only approved, mapped Slack captures and creates review proposals without auto-approval.
